content:
STAGE 1: evidence audit (rubric rank-2026-10-v1), 5 proposals, bundles c0d55832/EQVOTE c71aaa7b/CURVQUOTA 46d74349/geopull 6ea5e65b/QUOTAPERM 4f6c451e (shared OBSERVED evidence).

READ: proposals + bundles. Key OBSERVED: baseline 247/7414/20223, Stage3 test_recall@10 0.055537; 24556 train items -> ~99 items per level-1 code, ~3.3 per level-2 prefix, ~1.2 per triple. E8: co-location of behaviour pairs K=16 0.3106 / K=256 0.0822 vs negatives 0.0129. E11: same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 (only weak measured behaviour signal, at the coarse level). E6/E7: l1_br has 1.000 depth-1 survival, T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00, T4 NLL 9.03, recall 0.04671 (worst) -> prefix determinism alone is refuted; the entropy sits at the last token, so prefixes must become behaviour-INFORMATIVE. Anchors: round1 curvature-as-radius 170->56 triples recall 0.041888; round2 multiplicative weight moved 0 of 4 argmins. delta=[-0.328,-0.071,+0.399].

SCOPE: all five pass behaviour+geometry+coupling; geopull and QPEX name all three switches explicitly, EQVOTE/CURVQUOTA/QUOTAPERM only implicitly (hypothesis/risks).
CONSTANTS: QPEX lambda = median top-2 margin / median d_P (margin-calibrated, best controlled); EQVOTE lambda_l = s_l*median residual distortion; QUOTAPERM no coupling weight at all (rank fusion); CURVQUOTA has eta*kappa_hat up to ~4.4 against a normalised distance ~1; geopull's lambda_l is never derived anywhere.
SIGNS: EQVOTE gates s=[0,0,1] -> only level 3 where the quotient beats its size-null, levels 1-2 bit-identical. QUOTAPERM kappa=exp(delta)=0.72/0.93/1.49 -> weakest geometry at level 1, strongest at level 3. geopull t=sigmoid(delta), always-attract, strongest at level 3. QPEX signed delta at level 1 REWARDS hyperbolic distance (separates coarse groups) and mislabels level 1 as "fine". CURVQUOTA eta_1~-1.09 x kappa_hat~-2 gives +2.2 bias on successor codes at level 1 (and eta_2=-0.24) -> penalises the co-location it claims.
COST/RISK: QUOTAPERM 1.00x training, algebraic triple-bag conservation; QPEX +5-15%; CURVQUOTA +5-10% but re-parameterises the quantiser onto the Poincare ball with tangent EMA (same route as round 1); geopull caps refresh at 30 -> stale STE for ~2700/3000 epochs; EQVOTE 1.4-2x Stage-2 wall clock, self-declared "few thousandths" effect, geometry only a kernel bandwidth.
OPEN: ordering.

STAGE 2: ordering decision (same evidence as stage 1).

Criteria actually used, in order: (i) does the mechanism provably move the arg-min without touching capacity (additive + exact quota / conserved bag); (ii) is the sign of the curvature spend coherent with delta and with E11 (level-1 co-location is the only measured behaviour signal); (iii) can every constant be derived under the no-sweep policy; (iv) cost inside the frozen 3000-epoch four-card budget; (v) risk of reproducing round-1 collapse.

Placement: 1 QUOTAPERM-HYP (triple-bag conservation makes collapse algebraically impossible, no coupling weight to tune, 1.00x training, targets the E7 last-token bottleneck by making prefixes behaviour-aligned; weakest on explicit switch naming and it is post-hoc only). 2 EQVOTE-HYP-RQ (sign-clean [delta]_+ gate spends only level 3 = delta_3 +0.399, additive bounded vote, quota-exact; but geometry is only a kernel bandwidth and it self-declares 1.4-2x wall clock and a few-thousandths effect). 3 QPEX-CURVBIAS (best-controlled constant, lambda tied to the measured top-2 margin; but delta_1<0 rewards hyperbolic distance at level 1, i.e. separates the coarse groups that E11 measures at 0.0907 vs 0.067, and it mislabels level 1 as "fine"). 4 geopull-exactquota (real exp/log/Frechet geodesic interpolation, global not batch-local quota, explicit ABL switches; but lambda_l is undriven and the 30-refresh cap freezes the discrete assignment for ~2700 of 3000 epochs). 5 CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID (complete equations and guards, but re-parameterises the quantiser onto the Poincare ball with tangent EMA, the round-1 route, and its eta*kappa_hat bias penalises successor codes at levels 1-2 against its own stated aim, with |bias| ~4.4 vs distance ~1).

OUTPUT: the five RANK lines below were emitted as the answer block.

STAGE 3 (final answer):
RANK: QUOTAPERM-HYP | position=1 | reason=only proposal whose conservation is algebraic (whole-triple transpositions keep 247/7414/20223, 0.177 collision and every level histogram bit-identical), so the E-bundle round-1 failure (170->56 triples, recall 0.041888) is impossible, it has no coupling weight to sweep (rank fusion), costs 1.00x training, and it targets the measured bottleneck in E7 (l1_br: T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00 but T4 NLL 9.03 and recall 0.04671) by making prefixes behaviour-informative rather than merely deterministic.
RANK: EQVOTE-HYP-RQ | position=2 | reason=its [delta]_+ gate s=[0,0,1] spends the curvature only where the evidence says the quotient beats its size-null (delta_3=+0.399) while leaving levels 1-2 bit-identical, and the additive bounded vote plus transposition quotas makes the top-1 change provable and the capacity loss zero; demoted because its geometry enters only as a kernel bandwidth around a discrete vote (its own risk 4 admits near-inertness), it self-declares 1.4-2x Stage-2 wall clock on the frozen budget and a "few thousandths" effect.
RANK: QPEX-CURVBIAS | position=3 | reason=it has the best-calibrated constant of the five (lambda = median top-2 margin / median d_P, so the bias can neither repeat round 2's 0-of-4 argmin no-op nor swamp reconstruction) and quota-exact swaps with no radius involvement; placed below the top two because the signed delta makes the level-1 term (delta_1=-0.328) REWARD hyperbolic distance and so separate the coarse groups, the exact place where E11 measures the only behaviour signal in the existing SIDs (0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067).
RANK: geopull-exactquota | position=4 | reason=strongest geometric machinery (successor Frechet mean then exp_{x_i}(t_l log_{x_i}(m_i)) at fixed kappa=1, always-attract with t_l strongest at level 3, global rather than batch-local quotas, explicit ABL_BEHAVIOUR/ABL_GEOMETRY switches); demoted because lambda_l in cost=d_P^2+lambda_l*[d_P(g)-d_P(x)] is never derived anywhere in its spec (a coupling weight the no-tuning policy forbids choosing) and the 30-refresh cap freezes the discrete assignment for ~2700 of the 3000 epochs, leaving a stale STE target.
RANK: CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID | position=5 | reason=most complete equations/guards, but it moves the quantiser itself onto the Poincare ball (phi(z)=z/(1+||z||), d_P as primary cost, tangent-space EMA) which is the round-1 route that collapsed resolution (170->56, recall 0.041888), and its sign is self-defeating: eta_1~-1.09 times kappa_hat~-2 gives a bias near +2.2 penalising successor codes at level 1 (eta_2=-0.24 at level 2) against a normalised distance ~1, so its own predicted non-zero level-1 swaps move items away from their successors.
